intro: Wet room installation in Vogrie typically costs between £6,500 and £11,500, with most homeowners landing somewhere in the middle of that range depending on the size of the space and the level of finish they're after. It's a significant investment, but one that genuinely transforms a bathroom — especially in a home where a traditional shower enclosure feels cramped or dated. Wet rooms are increasingly popular across Midlothian for good reason: they're easier to clean, more accessible, and add real appeal when it comes to selling. If you're weighing up whether it's worth doing, the short answer for most Vogrie properties is yes — done properly, a wet room will last decades.
localContext: Vogrie sits in a quiet corner of Midlothian, and the housing stock here is varied in ways that genuinely affect how wet room projects get planned and priced. Older stone-built properties and period cottages make up a good portion of homes in the area, and these come with specific challenges — solid floors that need careful tanking, original pipework that may need rerouting, and walls that aren't always square or straightforward to tile. Getting the waterproofing right in these older builds is non-negotiable, and it takes an experienced installer who understands the quirks of traditional construction. Modern estate properties in Vogrie tend to be more straightforward, with timber-framed walls and accessible joist spaces, though they still require proper membrane systems and drainage planning. Vogrie sits in a moderately hard water area, which is worth factoring in when choosing your fixtures — limescale can dull chrome fittings and glass screens over time, so many local homeowners opt for matte or brushed finishes that are easier to maintain, or consider a water softener as part of the wider project.
serviceDetail: A proper wet room installation in Vogrie follows a clear process, and understanding what's involved helps you plan realistically. The first stage is a survey visit where the installer assesses the existing bathroom layout, checks the floor structure and drainage options, and talks through your preferences for layout, tiles, and fixtures. For ground-floor rooms in stone-built Vogrie properties, this often involves checking whether a new drain can be connected to the existing soil stack or whether a pump-assisted drainage solution is needed. Once the design is agreed, the room is fully stripped back. In older properties, this is often where surprises appear — corroded pipework, uneven substrates, or previous DIY work that needs undoing before progress can be made. The floor is then prepared and levelled to create the correct gradient toward the drain — usually around 1 in 50 — before a tanking membrane is applied across the floor and walls. This waterproofing stage is the most critical part of the whole job. After tanking is complete and inspected, the tiling or alternative wall finish goes on, the drain and shower valve are fitted, and the final touches — screens, lighting, towel rails — are installed. A good installation from survey to completion typically takes five to eight working days in a standard Vogrie bathroom.
pricing: In Vogrie, most wet room projects fall between £6,500 and £11,500 fully installed. A compact conversion in a modern estate property with mid-range tiles and fittings will sit toward the lower end of that range. Larger bathrooms, projects in older stone-built or period properties requiring additional prep work, or premium finishes like large-format porcelain, bespoke drainage channels, or thermostatic valve systems will push the cost higher. Underfloor heating, if not already present, typically adds £400–£900 depending on the floor area. Don't be tempted by unusually low quotes — cutting corners on tanking and drainage in a Vogrie home will cost far more to fix later than it saved upfront.
whyLocal: Choosing a tradesperson who knows Vogrie and the surrounding Midlothian area makes a practical difference on a job like this. Local installers will have worked in the same stone-built properties and period cottages you're dealing with, and they'll know what the floor structures tend to look like, how the drainage typically runs, and where the common gotchas are. They're also easier to reach if any aftercare is needed, and their reputation in a small community like Vogrie depends on the quality of their work. It's worth asking any installer you speak to whether they've worked on similar properties locally — the right answer tells you a lot.

faqs.q: Can a wet room be installed on an upper floor in an older Vogrie property?
faqs.a: Yes, but it requires more careful planning. Timber joists in older Vogrie properties need to be assessed for load capacity and may need reinforcing. The floor build-up for drainage and tanking adds weight and height, so a structural check is always advisable before committing. It's very doable, but it's not a job to rush the survey on.

faqs.q: How do I deal with limescale on wet room fittings in Vogrie?
faqs.a: Vogrie's moderately hard water supply means limescale will build up on chrome fittings and clear glass over time. Choosing brushed nickel, matte black, or gunmetal finishes makes maintenance significantly easier. Wiping down the walls after each use also helps a great deal. Some homeowners combine a wet room installation with a water softener, which largely eliminates the problem at source.

faqs.q: How long does a wet room installation take in Vogrie?
faqs.a: Most standard wet room installations in Vogrie take between five and eight working days from strip-out to final fit. Older stone-built properties or those with complicated drainage routes can extend this slightly. Your installer should give you a realistic timeline after the survey visit, not before — any quote provided without seeing the space should be treated with caution.

faqs.q: Does a wet room add value to a Vogrie home?
faqs.a: Generally yes, particularly when it replaces an outdated bathroom. A well-executed wet room with quality tiling and fittings is viewed positively by buyers across Midlothian. In period cottages and older Vogrie properties especially, a stylish, modern wet room can be a genuine selling point — provided the installation is done to a high standard with proper waterproofing throughout.
